items.title: File Klage against the rejection of the Bauantrag
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie binnen eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Klage beim Bayerischen Verwaltungsgericht Musterregensburg, Haidplatz 4, 93047 Musterregensburg erheben, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Geschäftsstelle des Gerichts.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 18 Nov 2026, sent by ordinary post. Under Art. 41 Abs. 2 BayVwVfG (as stated in the letter: 'gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben'), treating the printed date as the posting day, the notice is deemed delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting: 18 Nov + 4 days = Sun 22 Nov 2026. This deemed-delivery fiction is not shifted for falling on a weekend (settled case law on the equivalent §122 Abs.2 AO/§41 Abs.2 VwVfG rule). Bekanntgabe day = Sun 22 Nov 2026. The one-month Klage period under §§187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB (via Art. 31 BayVwVfG/§57 VwGO) then ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the Bekanntgabe day, i.e. Tue 22 Dec 2026. That day is a business day in Bayern (no public holiday), so no further shift under §193 BGB/§31 Abs.3 VwVfG is needed. Final day the Klage must reach the Verwaltungsgericht: 22 Dec 2026.

warnings: The letter itself does not state the actual posting date, only its printed date (18.11.2026); the computation assumes posting on that same day, which is the earliest plausible assumption and could push the deadline slightly later if posting was delayed.

In Bayern, matters that began before 1 January 2025 may still fall under the old 3-day deemed-delivery rule (Art. 98 BayVwVfG) rather than the 4-day rule the letter quotes; the case number 'B-2026-1406' suggests this Bauantrag began in 2026, so the 4-day rule (as stated in the letter) was applied, but this could not be independently confirmed.

The 120 € processing fee for the rejection will be billed separately via its own Kostenbescheid ('hierüber erhalten Sie einen eigenen Kostenbescheid'); no payment due date can be set from this letter alone.
No Widerspruch is available in this matter ('Ein Widerspruchsverfahren ist in dieser Sache nicht vorgesehen'); only Klage directly to the Verwaltungsgericht Musterregensburg is possible.
